create_MLP: create a multi-layer perceptron with configurable hidden dimensions, layers, and activation functions
create_MLPConfig: create an MLPConfig dataclass with embedding size, layer count, and task type settings
create_MLP_BC: build an MLP behavior cloning model for tasks like bc, id, fd, or rcbc
run_MLP_BC_forward: run the MLP_BC forward pass on trajectory data with optional loss computation
run_MLP_BC_evaluate: evaluate the MLP_BC model on an environment using behavior cloning or inverse dynamics
